My dear [Frances](/person/1604),
[Uncle Yonge](/person/1623) did not go today. I am sorry to say he has quite got a cold. [Helen](/person/1613) is very well and bright – Here is a curiosity by way of a German announcement of a betrothal
Your affect Sister

C M Yonge


[^1]: The letter must date between the birth of Helen Yonge and the death of the Rev.

John Yonge.
